Package domain

Class MatchType

java.lang.Object
domain.MatchType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
GoalsMatch, SurvivalMatch, TimeMatch
public abstract class MatchType extends Object implements Serializable
Rule that says when a match ends and who wins (Strategy pattern). The match is always the same; only this rule changes.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
